name: Turn One Note into a Pad
description: A sampler repeats a short region of one note for as long as each gate is high, and the run renders six seconds to a clip. Runs locally with no file, model or key.

data.comment:
# Turn One Note into a Pad

A one-second note becomes long, soft chords in a six-second clip. The run renders the clip faster than real time. Every step runs in the editor process, with no file, model or key.

**How it works:** "1 Note" is a Code node that writes a note with a plucked start and a steady body. "4 Pad" is a Sampler in the loop mode. Start and Length select ten periods of the steady body, and each voice repeats that region while its gate is high. Attack fades a voice in. When the gate falls, Release fades the voice out, so the end of one note sounds under the start of the next. "3 Pitch" gives each note its pitch: the root, the fourth, the minor seventh and the fourth. "5 Record" keeps six seconds and shows the clip. Its Duration is also the length of the render.

**Try this:** Set Mode on "4 Pad" to one_shot to hear the region one time for each note. Set Release to 2 for chords that stay, or replace "5 Record" with an Audio Out node to play the pad live.
